matrix.finding: Create, edit, save-as-draft and explicit publish actions already exist in one owner-controlled form.
Camera and gallery selection, sanitized backend upload and active-listing photo binding exist; an isolated AI-analysis derivative lifecycle does not.
Client and server enforce the same private-pilot category and subcategory positive list, including the Heilbronn-compatible tool categories.
Account scope controls, listing moderation state and review workflows exist; AI-draft validation, clarification and safety-bound provenance are not modeled.
Draft status exists, but the shared form and server payload require a nearly publish-complete listing; silently weakening Item or historical rows would violate rollback and data-preservation rules.
Publication is explicit, audited and photo-gated, but the current POST can create an active listing directly; AI output requires its own draft-first review boundary and must never auto-publish.
G5A is a separate deterministic post-publication owner flow, limited to reviewed category templates and explicit outcomes, with external generative AI false.
Manual daily price fields and a legacy local heuristic exist, but the heuristic uses coarse city multipliers and floating values and is not SIT_REGIONAL_PRICE_ENGINE_V2 authority.
The backend converts listing price to minor units and later issues immutable V5.2 quote and fee snapshots; price recommendation must feed the listing price without bypassing quote authority.
Listings and uploads are covered by export, erasure and retention inventories; prompt input, image-analysis derivatives and market observations need explicit lifecycles before use.
Broad AI and G5 surfaces fail closed, but no narrow listing-AI gateway flag, mock mode or budget gate exists yet.
